spatialRules.name: Rug Sizing & Seating Anchor
spatialRules.rule: In living rooms, the area rug should be large enough that at least the front two legs of all main seating pieces (sofas and armchairs) sit firmly on the rug. Standard sizes: 8x10 ft or 9x12 ft. Never float a tiny 'postage stamp' rug in the middle.

spatialRules.name: Sofa to Coffee Table Ergonomics
spatialRules.rule: Maintain 14 to 18 inches (35 to 45 cm) of clearance between the front edge of the sofa and the coffee table. This provides comfortable legroom while keeping drinks and books within easy arm's reach.

spatialRules.name: Coffee Table Height Ratio
spatialRules.rule: The top of the coffee table should be 1 to 2 inches lower than the seat cushion height of the adjacent sofa or sectional, usually between 16 to 18 inches high.

spatialRules.name: Three-Tier Lighting Strategy
spatialRules.rule: Every well-designed room must include 3 distinct layers of light: 1. Ambient lighting (central flush mount, chandelier, or cove lighting for general brightness); 2. Task lighting (desk lamps, floor reading lamps beside armchairs, bedside sconces); 3. Accent lighting (picture lights over art, LED strip backlighting on shelving, uplights).

spatialRules.name: Wall Art Eye-Level Standard
spatialRules.rule: The center point of single wall art pieces or gallery wall arrangements should hang at 57 to 60 inches (145-152 cm) from the finished floor (the average human standing eye-level). When hanging above a sofa or console, leave 8 to 10 inches between the top of the furniture and the bottom of the frame.

spatialRules.name: Curtain High-and-Wide Principle
spatialRules.rule: Mount curtain rods 4 to 6 inches above the window frame (or directly below the crown molding/ceiling) and extend the rod 8 to 12 inches wider than the window frame on each side. This tricks the eye into perceiving ceilings as higher and windows as larger, while letting maximum natural light enter.

spatialRules.name: Main Circulation Pathway Clearance
spatialRules.rule: Primary traffic pathways through the room must have a minimum unobstructed walkway clearance of 30 to 36 inches (76 to 91 cm). Secondary pathways between minor furniture pieces require at least 24 inches.

spatialRules.name: TV Viewing Distance & Height
spatialRules.rule: The vertical center of a wall-mounted TV screen should sit at eye level from the seated viewing position (typically 42 inches from the floor). Viewing distance should equal approximately 1.2 to 1.5 times the diagonal screen size.

colorRules.name: 60-30-10 Proportional Color Harmony
colorRules.rule: Divide room colors into 60% dominant base (walls, large rugs, primary sofa), 30% secondary supporting color (accent chairs, curtains, secondary furniture), and 10% accent color (cushions, artwork, decorative ceramics, hardware).

colorRules.name: Warm vs Cool Undertone Cohesion
colorRules.rule: Avoid clashing undertones by pairing warm whites (cream, ivory, alabaster) with warm woods (oak, walnut, brass) or cool whites (pure white, crisp grey) with cool metals (chrome, black steel, slate).

colorRules.name: Biophilic Natural Anchor
colorRules.rule: Introducing muted botanical greens (sage, eucalyptus, forest) anchors neutral interiors and reduces visual fatigue while harmonizing with light wood tones.

safetyRules.name: Toddler & Child Safety Furniture Standards
safetyRules.rule: For homes with toddlers or young children: 1. Avoid sharp-cornered rectangular glass coffee tables; select round, oval, or upholstered storage ottomans; 2. All heavy bookcases, media units, and dressers must be anchored to wall studs; 3. Choose stain-resistant performance fabrics (Crypton, Revolution, Sunbrella) and washable slipcovers.

topRankedChunks.title: 60-30-10 Proportional Color Harmony
topRankedChunks.content: Color Rule: 60-30-10 Proportional Color Harmony. Category: color_theory. Guideline: Divide room colors into 60% dominant base (walls, large rugs, primary sofa), 30% secondary supporting color (accent chairs, curtains, secondary furniture), and 10% accent color (cushions, artwork, decorative ceramics, hardware).

topRankedChunks.title: Rug Sizing & Seating Anchor
topRankedChunks.content: Spatial Rule: Rug Sizing & Seating Anchor. Room Type: living_room. Category: living_room. Rule: In living rooms, the area rug should be large enough that at least the front two legs of all main seating pieces (sofas and armchairs) sit firmly on the rug. Standard sizes: 8x10 ft or 9x12 ft. Never float a tiny 'postage stamp' rug in the middle.

designDirectives: Anchor seating with minimum front two legs on a large area rug (recommended 8x10 or 9x12 for home_office).
Maintain 14-18 inches clearance between sofa edge and coffee table.
Incorporate 3 layers of illumination: Ambient (ceiling pendant), Task (reading floor lamp), and Accent (warm LED/ceramic light).
Execute the 60-30-10 color rule: 60% dominant base (#FFFFFF), 30% secondary furniture (#E8F0F2), 10% accent textures (#4F6367).

Safety Directive: For homes with dogs or cats: 1. Avoid loose loop-pile or open-weave rugs that snag claws; choose low-pile flatweave, indoor/outdoor polypropylene, or machine-washable rugs; 2. Select tight-weave microfiber, distressed leather, or high rub-count performance velvet that resists pet hair and scratching; 3. Ensure indoor plants are strictly non-toxic (safe: Calathea, Parlor Palm, Spider Plant, Money Tree; avoid: Monsteras, Lilies, Philodendrons).
